title: Hoober
summary: Subdue Hoober so he can safely receive the quest elixir.
overview: Subdue Hoober so he can safely receive the quest elixir.

roles.label: Everyone
tips: Stop attacks at the surrender and have the quest turn-in ready.

sections.title: Encounter plan
bullets: Reduce Hoober to 20% health. He becomes invulnerable, falls down and clears his hate list.
That creates a five-minute window to give the required elixir.
Giving it before he is subdued returns the item and provokes him instead.
